### What it does


- **Finds your data.** Searches your connected tools for 2026 goals, roadmap, customer calls and research, and only asks about what it can't find.
- **Matches your brand.** Uses your brand guidelines, or the colors and fonts from your website.
- **Checks the facts with you first.** Shows a one-page fact sheet with sources before it builds a single slide.
- **Builds an 11-slide exec deck.** Wins first, then goals vs. outcomes, what customers told you, areas of opportunity for 2027 and your asks for leadership.
- **Flags thin bets.** Shows which 2027 bets don't have customer evidence behind them yet.


Every bet gets one verdict: Win, Partial win, Opportunity for 2027 or Too early to tell, defined the same way in every deck.


### Make it yours


Think of it as a starting point. Ask your AI to change the date range, zoom in on one product area, add the slide your CEO always asks for, or cut what you don't need.
